label: EX2300-24T 24-port 1G access switch
description: Juniper EX2300-24T 1RU access switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45 (ge-0/0/0-23), no PoE, 4x 1G/10G SFP/SFP+ uplinks (xe-0/1/0-3), 1x RJ-45 out-of-band management port, RJ-45 serial and mini-USB Type B console, 128 Gbps packet-switching capacity, 95 Mpps, 55 W maximum input power, 2 GB DRAM, 2 GB flash, image 15.1X53-D50 or later.

fabric.note: 128 Gbps bidirectional from the EX2300 datasheet (the 24-port group) and from the per-model hardware specs, which add 64 Gbps unidirectional and 95 Mpps at 64 B. The access ports are copper: the four uplink cages are the only SFP+ ports, and each takes a 1G SFP or a 10G SFP+, hence speedCaps [1000, 10000] on the uplinks only.

notes: Port roles from the per-model hardware specifications: 24 built-in RJ-45 access ports plus 4 SFP+ uplinks, 2 console ports (RJ-45 and mini-USB Type B), 1 RJ-45 management port and 1 USB Type A. 10.2 in / 25.9 cm deep, 3.29 kg, two fixed front-to-back fans, 34.2 dB. No PoE on this SKU: the T models have no PSE controller. Static routes and RIP are in the base licence; OSPF, IGMP/PIM, BFD, MLD and VRRP need the optional enhanced feature licence (datasheet, https://juniper.vn/public/cuploads/files/datasheet-juniper-ex2300.pdf). The catalogue entry this replaces carried the 24-port template and the four uplinks but declared no connector on either, so the copper access ports and the SFP+ cages were both being inferred from the port name.
